analysis_data.loc[mask_small_complement, 'Complement_Employee_Count'] = '<5 (suppressed)'

    'Department', 'JobLevel', 'AgeGroup',

    'Complement_Employee_Count', 'Complement_Total_Compensation_Formatted',

print(f"\nTop 10 segments by compensation (showing first 10 rows):")

    'Segment_Employee_Count': 'sum',
}).reset_index()

print(f"\n=== DEPARTMENT SUMMARY ===")

# Create visualization of segment distribution (aggregate level)

# Calculate total monthly compensation for each segment
segment_totals = sheet1_data.groupby(['Department', 'JobLevel', 'AgeGroup'])['MonthlyIncome'].agg(
    Segment_Total_Compensation='sum',
    Segment_Employee_Count='count'
).reset_index()

print(f"\nFound {len(segment_totals)} unique segments")

# Apply minimum aggregation size policy (at least 5 records)
segment_totals = segment_totals[segment_totals['Segment_Employee_Count'] >= 5].copy()
print(f"After applying minimum size policy (≥5 employees): {len(segment_totals)} segments")

# Calculate parent group totals (total compensation for each Department-JobLevel combination)
parent_group_totals = sheet1_data.groupby(['Department', 'JobLevel'])['MonthlyIncome'].agg(
    Parent_Total_Compensation='sum',
    Parent_Employee_Count='count'
).reset_index()

# Merge segment totals with parent group totals
analysis_data = pd.merge(
    segment_totals,
    parent_group_totals,
    on=['Department', 'JobLevel'],
    how='left'
)

# Calculate complement compensation (parent total minus segment total)
analysis_data['Complement_Total_Compensation'] = analysis_data['Parent_Total_Compensation'] - analysis_data['Segment_Total_Compensation']
analysis_data['Complement_Employee_Count'] = analysis_data['Parent_Employee_Count'] - analysis_data['Segment_Employee_Count']

# Calculate segment's share of parent total
analysis_data['Segment_Share_of_Parent'] = analysis_data['Segment_Total_Compensation'] / analysis_data['Parent_Total_Compensation']
analysis_data['Employee_Share_of_Parent'] = analysis_data['Segment_Employee_Count'] / analysis_data['Parent_Employee_Count']

analysis_data['Complement_Total_Compensation_Formatted'] = analysis_data['Complement_Total_Compensation'].apply(lambda x: f"${x:,.2f}")
analysis_data['Parent_Total_Compensation_Formatted'] = analysis_data['Parent_Total_Compensation'].apply(lambda x: f"${x:,.2f}")
analysis_data['Segment_Share_of_Parent_Formatted'] = analysis_data['Segment_Share_of_Parent'].apply(lambda x: f"{x:.1%}")

analysis_data.loc[mask_small_complement, 'Complement_Employee_Count'] = '<5 (suppressed)'
